GLS.feature.pf2e-fx.title: PF2e Spellsprite Effects
GLS.feature.pf2e-fx.hint: Hand-drawn style pixel-art animations for every spell, Strike, action and condition, played straight from chat on the 2D map and in the Diorama 3D view. Players restyle their own items, the GM restyles anything.
GLFX.Settings.Spells.Name: Animate spells
GLFX.Settings.Spells.Hint: Play an effect for spell attacks, saves and areas as they are cast.
GLFX.Settings.Strikes.Name: Animate Strikes
GLFX.Settings.Strikes.Hint: Play an effect for weapon and creature Strikes.
GLFX.Settings.Actions.Name: Animate actions and items
GLFX.Settings.Actions.Hint: Play an effect for actions, feats, class features and consumables that have an area, deal damage or have a clear purpose (healing, buffs, wards).
GLFX.Settings.Conditions.Name: Animate conditions
GLFX.Settings.Conditions.Hint: Show a small looping effect on creatures with a condition or persistent damage.
GLFX.Settings.StandDown.Name: Defer to Automated Animations
GLFX.Settings.StandDown.Hint: When Automated Animations is active and already animates an item, Spellsprite plays nothing for it.
GLFX.Settings.Floor.Name: Floor brightness
GLFX.Settings.Floor.Hint: How effects are lit on your screen. Automatic reads the scene's darkness and background. A scene flag set by the GM overrides this.
GLFX.Settings.ImpactFrames.Name: Impact frames
GLFX.Settings.ImpactFrames.Hint: Critical hits flash the table dark then pale for two frames.
GLFX.Settings.Shake.Name: Screen shake
GLFX.Settings.Shake.Hint: Heavy impacts shake the view by a few pixels.
GLFX.Settings.MaxConcurrent.Name: Maximum effects at once
GLFX.Settings.MaxConcurrent.Hint: The most one-shot effects your client plays together. The oldest stops first. Condition loops are not counted against it.
GLFX.Settings.Rules.Name: Effect looks
GLFX.Settings.Rules.Label: Edit world looks
GLFX.Settings.Rules.Hint: Restyle effects for the whole table: a world default and looks by item slug.
GLFX.look.title: Effect look: {name}
GLFX.look.hintItem: Restyle this item's effect. Empty fields follow the character, the GM's rules and the automatic look.
GLFX.look.hintActor: Restyle every effect this character makes. An item's own look wins over this one.
GLFX.rules.title: Spellsprite World Looks
GLFX.rules.hint: The default restyles every effect at the table. A slug rule restyles one item everywhere it appears, for example fireball or longsword. A character's or item's own look still wins.
